Title: Implementable Leaf-Task Selection & Preflight Resolution
Kind: Governance/preflight correction (M03 selection hardening; temporary DevBridge scaffolding for Nexus Phase 1/2; nothing migrates into Nexus)
Summary: The FINAL HARDENED LANE C TRIAL PART 1 post-closure run exposed an M03 SELECTION DEFECT (not a governance-state gap): with the trial-closed WI-07-0.2.4 correctly excluded by proving history, M03 auto-selected the CURRENT WORK anchor M-07-0.2 - a Milestone CONTAINER - as 'the task', then preflight hit SCOPE_INCOMPLETE / RESOLVE_PREFLIGHT because a container carries no derivable implementation scope. M03 was returning a container as the selection target, which the governed contract forbids (only an IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF may be reserved/handed off). DB-M03.1 hardens M03 end-to-end: (1) deterministic node implementability classification Get-ImplementabilityClass driven by the governed NodeType column + BreakdownComplete + child presence (NodeId prefixes NOT used); (2) container->leaf resolution Resolve-ImplementableDescendant (DFS pre-order over governed reading order, dependencies satisfied, trial-proving excluded, TRIAL only); (3) leaf-selection validation leafValidation[] emitted into preflight.json (identity/hierarchy/execution-state/dependencies/AC inheritance/no-conflict); (4) honest block tokens NO_IMPLEMENTABLE_DESCENDANT / HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED / IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN that short-circuit preflight BEFORE scope derivation (plus pre-existing SCOPE_INCOMPLETE for a selected leaf and TASK_SELECTION_AMBIGUOUS for no-target); (5) CURRENT WORK FIRST and NEXT WORK fallback ordering preserved; (6) M04 gate: RESERVE refuses any classified non-leaf with STOP_NOT_IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF while remaining backward compatible with legacy state lacking the implementability field (E30); (7) M05 gate: handoff refuses a container with HANDOFF_CONTAINER_PROHIBITED while remaining backward compatible with legacy state (E32); (8) the M-07-0.2 Milestone-container defect is reproduced safely in fixtures and proven resolved (matrix A/B/C). Proof: 40-check matrix (A1-A10 classification, B11-B17 container resolution, C18-C23 selection flow, D24-D28 preflight integration, E29-E32 M04/M05 gates, I1-I4 invariants + build) all PASS with exit 0, plus regressions Test-DBM124 54/54 (S8/S9 rewritten for capability k), Test-DBM04Safety 26/26, Test-DBM12-2Commands 59/59, GH01 M10 eligibility M10_BLOCKED / TRIAL_COMPLETION_NOT_APPLICABLE / verification PASS, DevBridge.Tests 410/410, DevBridge.UITests 65/65, solution build 0 errors / 0 warnings. All testing used byte-identical fixture workbook copies under logs\selftest\db-m03-1; the authoritative NEXUS_DEVELOPMENT_CONTROL.xlsx (SHA unchanged 6D42C3BF...E4F5), the Nexus repo git state, and live state/current-task.json are asserted byte-identical. NO live M04 reserve, NO live M05 handoff, NO workbook mutation, NO Nexus source change, and NO manual selection were performed.

RootCause.Observation: M03 returned the Milestone container M-07-0.2 as the selected task (post-closure current-work anchor), producing a preflight SCOPE_INCOMPLETE / RESOLVE_PREFLIGHT instead of resolving to an implementable leaf.
RootCause.Classification: M03 SELECTION DEFECT (container surfaced as the task, contrary to the governed leaf-only contract)
RootCause.WhyGap: M03 selected an anchor node without first determining whether that node is implementable; a Milestone/Layer/Feature container, or a WorkItem/Task with children or incomplete breakdown, has no derivable implementation scope and can never be reserved or handed off.
RootCause.Correction: Deterministic Get-ImplementabilityClass + container->leaf Resolve-ImplementableDescendant + leafValidation[] + honest block tokens; M04 and M05 gates refuse classified non-leaf targets with explicit STOP codes while preserving backward compatibility for legacy state (E30/E32).

EngineSurface.Classification: Get-ImplementabilityClass: Layer/Feature/Milestone -> NON_IMPLEMENTABLE_CONTAINER; WorkItem/Task BreakdownComplete=No -> INCOMPLETE_WORK_ITEM; WorkItem/Task leaf (no children, breakdown blank) -> IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF; WorkItem/Task with children -> NON_IMPLEMENTABLE_CONTAINER; Subtask -> IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF; unknown NodeType -> UNKNOWN_NODE_TYPE. NodeId prefixes never used.
EngineSurface.ContainerResolution: Resolve-ImplementableDescendant: DFS pre-order over governed reading order (SortKey ascending then Row ascending); candidate leaf iff class==IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF AND Test-DepsSatisfied AND not trial-proven-excluded (TRIAL only); returns {leaf, chain, reason}.
EngineSurface.LeafValidation: leafValidation[] in preflight.json: identity, hierarchy (anchor + resolution chain), execution state (not terminal, no open conflict), dependencies re-verified, acceptance criteria inherited from nearest AC-carrying Milestone (AC_INHERITED / AC_ABSENT_WARN), repo/project informational, no conflict, no incompatible reservation.
EngineSurface.BlockTokens: NO_IMPLEMENTABLE_DESCENDANT / HUMAN_GOVERNANCE_REQUIRED / IMPLEMENTATION_TARGET_UNKNOWN -> current-task.json status PREFLIGHTED, nodeId=anchor, nextAllowedAction RESOLVE_GOVERNANCE_BLOCK, preflight verdict=token; SCOPE_INCOMPLETE remains post-selection verdict for a selected leaf; TASK_SELECTION_AMBIGUOUS pre-existing minimal path.
EngineSurface.M04Gate: Reserve-DevelopmentChange.ps1: implementability field present and != IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF -> STOP_NOT_IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF (backward compatible: legacy state without the field reserves normally).
EngineSurface.M05Gate: New-ChatGptHandoff.ps1: implementability field present and != IMPLEMENTABLE_LEAF -> HANDOFF_CONTAINER_PROHIBITED (backward compatible: legacy state without the field hands off normally).
EngineSurface.SelectionFlow: Get-NextTask.ps1: anchor = CURRENT WORK first, else NEXT WORK fallback (unchanged); leaf anchor -> leaf validation -> SELECTED; container/incomplete/unknown anchor -> Resolve-ImplementableDescendant -> SELECTED leaf with SelectionBasis chain, or governed block with Candidates preserved for transparency.
